mapper.select: SELECT * FROM initial_installment ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO initial_installment (card_id, remaining_months, remaining_amount, memo, active, first_payment_date) VALUES (#{cardId}, #{remainingMonths}, #{remainingAmount}, #{memo}, #{active}, #{firstPaymentDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE initial_installment SET card_id=#{cardId}, remaining_months=#{remainingMonths}, remaining_amount=#{remainingAmount}, memo=#{memo}, active=#{active}, first_payment_date=#{firstPaymentDate}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
